problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $X,$ given by

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 5 & -1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 & -2 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{1}$ on $X?$
worked_solution:
The operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{1}$ means that we need to add $-1$ times the first row to the second row. 

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}X & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 5 & -1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 & -2 & 3\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1+(-1)(1) & 5+(-1)(3) & -1+(-1)(2) & 2+(-1)(1) \\ 3 & 4 & -2 & 3\end{aligned}] \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & -3 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & -2 & 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
